Name: Colored Seeds for Crop Mods
Author: kazuakisama
Description:
Colored Seeds Patches for Crop mods. Now with much easier install.

Supports:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1721?tab=description]Fresh Meat[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4472?tab=files]Ancient Crops[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028]Mizu's Flowers[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1610]Fantasy Crops[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]Fruits and Veggies[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6113]Garden Village[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6113]Ssaturn's Tropical Farm[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5217]Gemstone Fruits[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6064]Korea Blossom[/url]
[/list]
Installation: Extract the contents from the .zip and put them in Stardew Valley/mods folder. Much easier this time. You still need the original mods so go download those too.

Obviously best used in conjunction with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3774]Colored Seeds
[/url]
